info.title: suchi API
info.description: Document management as a single Go binary. This document is served live at /api/schema/. Auth: `Authorization: Token <hex>` (canonical) or `Bearer <hex>` (accepted alias) for the API surface; browser sessions use a cookie set by POST /login.

count.description: Total matching filter, not the length of results.

next.description: Relative URL to the next page; empty when none.

previous.description: Relative URL to the previous page; empty when none.

get.summary: Return the resolved principal + user profile fields (display_name, avatar_url).

patch.summary: Update the caller's display_name. email changes rejected with code=email_change_unsupported (needs a dedicated flow). Body {display_name?}.

post.summary: Multipart upload; field `avatar` (png/jpeg, ≤2MB, ≤2048x2048). Server sniffs Content-Type + re-encodes as PNG (strips EXIF, kills polyglot bytes). Returns the fresh UserSelf.

get.summary: Serve any user's avatar. image/png, immutable ETag = users.avatar_sha. 404 when unset.

post.summary: Exchange local credentials for an API token (mobile-compat).
Same handler as /api/token/ — accepts JSON or form.

get.summary: Paginated ACL-scoped list. Filters: jd_category_id, sensitivity, document_type__id, tags__id__in (AND), correspondents__id__in (OR), q (FTS5), created_at__gte, created_at__lte, trashed. Ordering allow-list: (-)created_at, (-)updated_at, (-)title. DRF envelope with slim DocumentListRow projection (no content — use /{id} for detail).
Page-1 thumbnail (PNG, ~40 DPI) rendered at ingest via pdftoppm. Immutable ETag = documents.thumb_sha. 404 for non-PDFs, docs ingested on a slim image without pdftoppm, or older docs pre-migration.

Documents like this one. Pure-Go FTS5 more-like-this today: top-10 tokens from source content ORed as an FTS5 MATCH query, ranked by BM25, visibility-scoped, source excluded. ?limit=N (1-50, default 10). method="fts" today; "vec" once sqlite-vec ships (see wishlist/similar-documents).
Pending Auto-file-from-archive proposals for one doc (owner or ACL:view). Each row carries field, value_id, label, confidence, and the neighbour doc IDs in based_on.

post.summary: Resolve one proposal. Body {action:"apply"|"reject"}. Applies via UPDATE-with-null-guard so a user's edit between propose and apply is preserved.

Resolve N proposals in one call. Body {proposal_ids:[..], action:"apply"|"reject"}. Per-id ACL check + per-id result array; forbidden entries come back as {id, ok:false, code:"forbidden"} while the rest apply. Cap 500.

Batch metadata mutation. Body {documents:[ids], method, parameters}. Methods: set_correspondent, set_document_type, set_storage_path, set_jd_category, set_sensitivity, add_tag, remove_tag, trash, restore. One tx, one audit event, per-id ACL result array. Cap 500 documents per call. Wire shape matches the mobile-compat DMS vocabulary suchi already speaks.

patch.summary: Update tag (admin). Body: partial {name, slug, color}. Parent moves live on /parent.

delete.summary: Delete tag (admin). Cascades document_tags; children re-root via ON DELETE SET NULL.

get.summary: Read mail-intake settings (admin). Password field is write-only — never returned.

put.summary: Persist mail-intake settings (admin). Body {imap_host, imap_port, username, password?, folder, poll_interval_min, owner_email}. Blank password keeps stored value. Response includes restart_required=true — no live reload today.

post.summary: Dial the IMAP server + LOGIN with submitted or stored creds (admin). Returns {ok, message}. Never 500s on a connect-refused.

get.summary: FTS5 search over title + content. Ranking is BM25F (title weighted 3× over content) blended with an exponential recency-decay boost (30-day half-life). `?recency=off` disables the recency term for raw BM25F ordering. Structured filters: `tags__id__in`, `correspondents__id__in`, `document_type__id`, `jd_category_id`, `sensitivity`. ACL-scoped for non-admins.
List caller's saved views. ?include=shared also returns every other user's shared=true view (shared rows carry an owner_id field). Body accepts {name, filter_json, display, position, shared}.

post.summary: Create a share link. Body {doc_ids:[...], label, password?, expires_at?}. doc_ids accepts 1 to 200 ids — a multi-doc bundle shares under one token ("everything for the accountant").

get.summary: Public metadata for a share bundle. Returns {label, docs:[{id, title, mime, size, download}], requires_password?}. Rate-limited.
Public streaming download for one doc in a bundle. Rate-limited; verifies the token + optional ?password= server-side.
Static schema of trigger codes + action kinds + per-kind param specs the current server understands. SPA visual builder reads this to render pickers so a new kind lands with no client release.

patch.summary: Replace the workflow row + triggers + actions wholesale (admin). Field-sparse edits aren't supported — send the full object.

get.summary: List JD categories with denormalized area info. ?q=<prefix> matches code or name; ?area=<code> scopes to one area (start code).
Admin-only setup-wizard preset catalog. One row per built-in preset with {id, name, description, blank, areas:[{code, name, category_count}]}. No envelope (bounded population).
Cursor over audit_events. ?since_id, ?kinds=csv, ?limit up to 200. Doc-centric rows filtered by ACL; job.dead + backup.written admin-only. Requires events:read.
Dashboard counters in one round-trip. documents_total, trash_count, inbox_count, inbox_category_id, pending_approvals, dead_jobs (admin only), ingested_7d. All counts visibility-scoped per principal.
Inline stream of the archive blob (or original if no archive). Same handler + sensitivity gate + ETag as /preview/{id}; the /api mirror lets headless deploys keep blob access.
Attachment stream of the archive (or ?original=1 for the raw file). Same handler as /download/{id}; /api mirror for headless deploys.
